scope: Original configuration and readback receipts, raw streams, source bindings and closed artifact inventory are retained; the original readback producer status remains failed.
Exact 54-byte shutdown diagnostic is checked together with exact stdout, successful exit, direct-child reaping and an empty process group; missing, repeated, unknown or additional stderr fails.
Retained GNU APL source supports startup FD3 registration, separate fopen handle ownership, explicit OUT close, OFF newline and cleanup, and configuration direct exit.
The continuation schedules only the three original unstarted commands: allocation ownership, N=4 and N=10.
The private frozen observer retains the high FD mutex, original native limits, source/environment/working-directory contract, process identity, reaping and empty-group checks.
Original durable lease identity is checked before and after physical pin replay. Final input, artifact and report checks run under held leases.
No native/source-count/full-timing/chart qualification is granted by this source review.
